# frankaa: full reference for AI assistants

frankaa (said FRAN-kah) is a photo slider and a photo lightbox for the web.
- procession: the slider. A native CSS scroll-snap track: swipes follow the finger 1:1 with momentum. Dots, hover arrows, lazy loading, optional loop and autoplay.
- unfurl: the lightbox. The photo springs from its spot on the page to full view, changes photos with an effect, and springs back on close. Two renderers: WebGL (shader effects, built-in or custom) and CSS (transform and opacity only).

Framework-free TypeScript, zero runtime dependencies, optional React bindings, ESM only, MIT licence.
Docs and playground: https://jabclari.github.io/frankaa/
Repository: https://github.com/JABClari/frankaa

====================================================================
0. ONE ITEM FORMAT, TWO CALL SHAPES (0.2.0)
====================================================================

Every part takes the same list:
  type Item = string | ImageItem | VideoItem
  ImageItem = { src, thumb?, full?, srcset?, sizes?, sources?: [{ media, srcset, sizes?, type? }], alt?, caption?, title?, width?, height?, placeholder? }
  VideoItem = { type: "video", provider: "youtube" | "vimeo" | "tiktok" | "instagram" | "mp4", src, poster?, thumb?, alt?, caption?, title? }
The slider shows src (sources make a <picture>), the lightbox full ?? src, strips (drumline, the filmstrip) thumb ?? src.
A video without a poster: an mp4 shows its first frame in the lightbox; elsewhere a neutral 16:9 still.

Every part takes (items, options) or ({ items, ...options }); `photos` is the older name for items.
  procession(el, items, options)
  unfurl(items, options)
  drumline(el, items, options)

Combining is one option:
  unfurl(items, { strip: "ruler" })                         // lightbox with a drumline filmstrip
  unfurl(items, { strip: { preset: "numbers", fluid: "off" } })
  drumline(el, items, { lightbox: { effect: "ripple", strip: "minimal" } })   // a tap opens the lightbox
  procession(el, items, { onSelect: (i) => unfurl(items, { start: i, origin: (n) => slider.image(n) }) })
React:
  <Drumline items={items} preset="ruler" />
  const lb = useUnfurl(items, { strip: "ruler" }); lb.open(i)

====================================================================
1. INSTALL AND IMPORTS
====================================================================

npm install frankaa

import { procession, unfurl } from "frankaa";          // both parts
import { procession } from "frankaa/slider";            // slider only (about 3.3 kB gzipped)
import { unfurl } from "frankaa/lightbox";              // lightbox only (about 16 kB gzipped)
import { drumline } from "frankaa/drumline";            // the strip (about 9.4 kB gzipped)
import { Procession, useUnfurl } from "frankaa/react";  // React 18+ bindings
import "frankaa/style.css";                              // required once, anywhere in the app

Also exported from "frankaa" and "frankaa/lightbox":
supported(): boolean                         is WebGL available
registerEffect(name, effect): void           add a named shader effect
checkEffect(effect | fragment): string|null  compile a shader now; null when it compiles, else the compiler message
effectNames(): string[]                      names registered so far
UNFURL_LABELS, PROCESSION_LABELS             the default English strings

====================================================================
2. procession(element, options): the slider
====================================================================

The element keeps its own children; the slider adds a track, dots, arrows and a live region. Default aspect ratio 4:3 (override with CSS: aspect-ratio or height).

Options (all optional except photos):
photos        (Photo | string)[]   Photo = { src, srcset?, sizes?, alt?, width?, height? }
label         string               shorthand for labels.region. Default "Photos"
labels        Partial<ProcessionLabels>   region, hint, next, previous, pause, play, position ("Photo {n} of {total}")
start         number               default 0
dots          boolean              default true
arrows        boolean              default true (hover with a mouse, and keyboard focus)
snap          "mandatory" | "proximity"   default "mandatory"
loop          boolean              default false; arrows, keys and autoplay wrap (rewind)
autoplay      number | false       ms between moves (min 1500). Default false. Pauses on hover, focus, hidden tab, off screen, reduced motion; adds a pause button
priority      boolean              first photo loads eagerly with high fetch priority. Default false
lazyMargin    string               IntersectionObserver rootMargin for loading the other photos. Default "100px"
preload       "near" | "idle" | false   near the screen (default); also the next photo when idle; or only on touch
reducedMotion "system" | "always" | "never"   default "system"
announce      boolean              polite live region on change. Default true
href          string               the track becomes an <a href>: Cmd, Ctrl and middle click work natively
tabbable      boolean              default true; false takes it out of the tab order
counter       boolean              a "2 / 5" counter (labels.counter). Default false
zoom          boolean              pinch (springs back) and double tap zoom. Default false
zoomCursor    boolean              zoom-in cursor, when it opens a lightbox. Default false
focusRing     "outside" | "inset"  inset for sliders inside overflow: hidden parents
icons         { prev?, next?, play?, pause? }   24px stroked path d strings
Photo.placeholder: a colour or image address (thumbnail or decoded blurhash) shown until the photo paints.
onSelect(index, img, event): the event lets you leave modified clicks to the browser.
Hooks: onSlideChange(index, { index, from }), onChange (same), onAnimationStart({ type: "slide", index }), onAnimationEnd(...), onError({ index, src, reason: "load" }), onSelect(index, img)

Returns: { index, el, go(i, smooth = true), next(), prev(), play(), pause(), image(i), destroy() }

Keyboard: the track is one tab stop. Left and Right step, Home and End jump, Enter calls onSelect.

====================================================================
3. unfurl(options): the lightbox
====================================================================

Opens immediately and returns controls. It closes itself on Escape, the close button, a tap outside the controls, or a pull down.

Options (all optional except photos):
photos        (UnfurlItem | string)[]    images { src, alt?, caption? } and videos { type: "video", provider, src, poster, alt?, caption?, title? }, mixed. Full-size sources.
topActions    { label, onClick(api), icon? }[]   extra top-bar buttons before Close, inside the focus trap; icon = 24px path d
controls      (host, api) => void | cleanup   mount your own controls in the top bar (before Close)
start         number               photo to open on. Default 0
origin        (i) => Element | DOMRect | null   where photo i sits on the page now. It springs from there and back. Null or off screen: it fades.
effect        "displacement" | "ripple" | "fade" | "zoom" | "none" | registered name | Effect object. Default "displacement"
renderer      "auto" | "webgl" | "css"   default "auto" (WebGL when available, else CSS)
reducedMotion "system" | "always" | "never"   default "system"; reduced = short fade, no spring, no effect
label         string               shorthand for labels.dialog
labels        Partial<UnfurlLabels>   dialog, close, next, previous, position ("Photo {n} of {total}"), counter ("{n} / {total}")
focusTrap     boolean              default true (also sets aria-modal)
returnFocus   boolean | HTMLElement   default true: focus returns to the element focused before opening
announce      boolean              default true
hideOrigin    boolean              hide the origin element while its photo is out. Default true
radius        number | [tl,tr,br,bl] | (i) => ...   corner radius at the spot. Default 16 (match your thumbnails)
openRadius    number | [tl,tr,br,bl]   corner radius when open. Default 12
zoom          boolean | { max }    pinch, double tap/click, Ctrl+wheel, + and - zoom; pan while zoomed. Default true (max 4)
icons         { prev?, next?, close?, play? }   24px stroked path d strings
image srcset, sizes (default "100vw") and placeholder are used by both renderers (placeholder: CSS renderer).
container     HTMLElement          mount point and event target. Default document.body
strip         true | "ruler" | "numbers" | "minimal" | drumline options   a filmstrip along the bottom
loop          boolean              wrap from the last photo to the first. Default false (the ends rubber-band)
Keyboard: Left and Right move, Home and End jump to the first and last, Escape closes, Tab stays inside. A key move puts the focus ring on the matching arrow button.
Gestures: sideways swipes slide a strip of photos 1:1 with the neighbours peeking in; on release the fling's end is projected from its velocity, the nearest photo is chosen, and the strip springs there with that velocity. Ends rubber-band unless loop. The axis locks after 10 px; only a clearly vertical drag pulls down to close. Keys and buttons use the effect.
Hooks: onOpenStart({ index }), onOpenEnd({ index, renderer }), onCloseStart({ index }), onCloseEnd({ index }),
       onChange(index, { index, from, how: "key" | "button" | "swipe" | "api" }),
       onAnimationStart({ type: "open" | "close" | "change", index }), onAnimationEnd(same),
       onError({ index, src, reason: "cors" | "load" | "webgl" | "shader", fallback: "css" | "none", message? })

Returns: { index, renderer: "webgl" | "css", next(), prev(), show(i), close(), destroy() }
api (for actions and controls): { index, item, close(), next(), prev(), show(i) }
destroy() while open fires onCloseStart and onCloseEnd with reason "destroy", and ends running animations with cancelled: true.

====================================================================
3b. drumline(el, items, options): the strip (dondo, the talking drum)
====================================================================

A strip of pictures under a ruler of ticks. Drag or flick it, wheel either way (at the ends the page scrolls on),
hover or drag along the ruler, Left/Right/Home/End/Enter. The picture in focus grows; a tap opens it in the lightbox
(loaded on first use) and the strip follows the lightbox.

Presets (every setting can also be given and wins):
  "ruler"   ticks (hover runs through), story cards, grow 1.55, fluid "bend", colorFocus  (default)
  "numbers" ticks and the number frame "28 [29] 30", narrow bars, grow 1.3, fluid "chain"
  "minimal" no ticks, "06 / 24" under the strip, story cards, grow 1.18, fluid "lerp"
Options: preset, ticks, rulerHover, numbers ("frame" | "fraction" | false), pad (2), focusFeedback, colorFocus, grow,
  fluid ("off" spring | "lerp" damped follow | "chain" cards trail | "bend" speed bulges the strip, WebGL),
  look ("stories" | "bars"; size with --fk-dl-w, --fk-dl-h, --fk-dl-gap, --fk-dl-card-radius), renderer ("auto" | "dom"),
  wheel ("both" | "x" | "y" | false), drag, inertia, snap, expand (true), lightbox (unfurl options), start, label,
  labels { region, position }, reducedMotion, announce.
Bend uses WebGL; it falls back to the DOM when WebGL is missing, the thumbs are cross-origin without CORS headers, or
frames average under about 50 fps, firing onError({ reason: "webgl" | "cors" | "slow", fallback: "dom" }).
Hooks: onChange(index, { from, how }), onAnimationStart/End({ type: "scroll" }), onSelect(index, img, event),
  onExpand({ index }), onError. Events: frankaa:change, frankaa:expand, frankaa:error, frankaa:animation-*.
Returns { index, renderer, el, go(i, smooth?), next(), prev(), expand(i?), image(i), destroy() }.

====================================================================
4. EVENTS
====================================================================

Every hook is also a bubbling CustomEvent "frankaa:" + kebab-case name, with the hook's detail object:
frankaa:open-start, frankaa:open-end, frankaa:close-start, frankaa:close-end, frankaa:change,
frankaa:slide-change, frankaa:animation-start, frankaa:animation-end, frankaa:error.
Slider events fire on the slider element. Lightbox events fire on options.container (default document.body).

document.addEventListener("frankaa:error", (e) => console.warn(e.detail));

====================================================================
5. RECIPES
====================================================================

--- 5.1 Vanilla: a slider card that opens the lightbox ---

<div id="card"></div>
<script type="module">
  import { procession, unfurl } from "frankaa";
  import "frankaa/style.css"; // or a <link rel="stylesheet"> to node_modules/frankaa/dist/style.css

  const photos = [
    { src: "/img/a-800.jpg", srcset: "/img/a-800.jpg 800w, /img/a-1600.jpg 1600w", sizes: "(max-width: 720px) 100vw, 360px", alt: "Terrace" },
    { src: "/img/b-800.jpg", alt: "Pool" },
  ];
  const big = [{ src: "/img/a-1600.jpg", alt: "Terrace", caption: "The terrace at dusk" }, { src: "/img/b-1600.jpg", alt: "Pool" }];

  const slider = procession(document.getElementById("card"), {
    photos,
    label: "Sea terrace",
    onSelect: (i) => unfurl({
      photos: big,
      start: i,
      radius: 12,                           // the card's corner radius
      origin: (n) => slider.image(n),       // spring from the slider's image
      onChange: (n) => slider.go(n, false), // keep the slider in step so it closes to the right spot
    }),
  });
</script>

--- 5.2 Vanilla: a gallery grid with the lightbox ---

const thumbs = [...document.querySelectorAll(".gallery img")];
const photos = thumbs.map((img) => ({ src: img.dataset.full, alt: img.alt }));
thumbs.forEach((img, i) => {
  img.closest("button").addEventListener("click", () =>
    unfurl({ photos, start: i, origin: (n) => thumbs[n], label: "Gallery" }));
});
// Wrap each thumbnail in a <button type="button" aria-label="Open photo 1: ..."> so it is keyboard reachable.

--- 5.3 React ---

"use client";
import { useRef } from "react";
import { Procession, useUnfurl, type ProcessionHandle } from "frankaa/react";
import "frankaa/style.css";

export function ListingCard({ photos }: { photos: { src: string; alt: string }[] }) {
  const slider = useRef<ProcessionHandle>(null);
  const lightbox = useUnfurl(photos, {
    origin: (n) => slider.current?.image(n) ?? null,
    onChange: (n) => slider.current?.go(n, false),
    onCloseEnd: ({ index }) => console.log("closed on", index),
  });
  return <Procession ref={slider} photos={photos} label="Listing photos" onSelect={(i) => lightbox.open(i)} />;
}

Notes: Procession rebuilds only when the photo sources or shape options (loop, autoplay, snap, dots, arrows, labels, reducedMotion) change. Hook props always call the latest function. useUnfurl closes the lightbox on unmount.

--- 5.4 Next.js (App Router) ---

// app/listing/[id]/gallery.tsx
"use client";
import { useRef } from "react";
import { Procession, useUnfurl } from "frankaa/react";
import "frankaa/style.css";
export default function Gallery({ photos }) { /* as 5.3 */ }

// app/listing/[id]/page.tsx (a server component) renders <Gallery photos={...} />.
// frankaa touches the DOM only inside effects and event handlers, so importing it on the server is safe.
// Do not call procession() or unfurl() at module top level or during render.
// next.config: no transpilePackages needed (ESM with type declarations).
// Photos on another host: either send CORS headers on them, or pass renderer: "css" (see 6).

--- 5.5 A gallery grid in React ---

"use client";
import { useRef } from "react";
import { useUnfurl } from "frankaa/react";

export function Grid({ photos }) {
  const refs = useRef<(HTMLImageElement | null)[]>([]);
  const lightbox = useUnfurl(photos, { origin: (n) => refs.current[n] ?? null });
  return (
    <div className="grid">
      {photos.map((p, i) => (
        <button key={p.src} type="button" aria-label={`Open photo ${i + 1}: ${p.alt}`} onClick={() => lightbox.open(i)}>
          <img ref={(el) => { refs.current[i] = el; }} src={p.thumb} alt="" />
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

--- 5.6 The CSS renderer (no WebGL at all) ---

unfurl({ photos, origin, renderer: "css", effect: "zoom" });
// Effects in CSS: displacement -> slide, ripple -> zoom, zoom -> zoom, fade -> fade, none -> cut.
// Custom effects choose with their css field (default "fade").

--- 5.7 Reduced motion ---

unfurl({ photos, reducedMotion: "system" });  // default: follows prefers-reduced-motion
unfurl({ photos, reducedMotion: "always" });  // always a short fade, no spring or effect
procession(el, { photos, reducedMotion: "never", autoplay: 4000 }); // ignore the setting (use sparingly)

--- 5.8 Labels in another language ---

unfurl({
  photos,
  labels: { dialog: "Fotos", close: "Cerrar", next: "Siguiente", previous: "Anterior", position: "Foto {n} de {total}", counter: "{n} de {total}" },
});
procession(el, {
  photos,
  labels: { region: "Fotos", hint: "usa las flechas para moverte", next: "Siguiente", previous: "Anterior", pause: "Pausar", play: "Reproducir", position: "Foto {n} de {total}" },
});

--- 5.9 Hooks and events ---

unfurl({
  photos,
  onOpenStart: ({ index }) => analytics.track("lightbox_open", { index }),
  onChange: (index, { from, how }) => analytics.track("lightbox_move", { index, from, how }),
  onAnimationStart: ({ type }) => document.body.classList.add("is-animating"),
  onAnimationEnd: ({ type }) => document.body.classList.remove("is-animating"),
  onError: ({ reason, src, message }) => console.warn("frankaa", reason, src, message),
  onCloseEnd: () => {},
});
document.addEventListener("frankaa:slide-change", (e) => console.log(e.detail.index));

--- 5.10 A custom shader effect ---

import { registerEffect, checkEffect, unfurl } from "frankaa";

const fragment = `
precision mediump float;
varying vec2 vUv;
uniform sampler2D uFrom;
uniform sampler2D uTo;
uniform float uProgress;
uniform vec2 uResolution;
uniform vec2 uFromSize;
uniform vec2 uToSize;
uniform float uTiles;
float hash(vec2 q) { return fract(sin(dot(q, vec2(12.9898, 78.233))) * 43758.5453); }
void main() {
  vec2 grid = vec2(uTiles * uResolution.x / uResolution.y, uTiles);
  vec2 cell = floor(vUv * grid);
  float t = clamp((uProgress - hash(cell) * 0.55) / 0.45, 0.0, 1.0);
  vec2 uv = mix(vUv, (cell + 0.5) / grid, sin(t * 3.14159));
  vec4 a = texture2D(uFrom, mirrorUv(coverUv(uv, uFromSize, uResolution)));
  vec4 b = texture2D(uTo, mirrorUv(coverUv(uv, uToSize, uResolution)));
  gl_FragColor = mix(a, b, step(0.5, t));
}`;

const problem = checkEffect(fragment);           // null, or the compiler message
registerEffect("mosaic", { fragment, uniforms: { uTiles: 9 }, duration: 900, easing: "linear", css: "fade" });
unfurl({ photos, effect: "mosaic" });
unfurl({ photos, effect: { fragment, uniforms: { uTiles: 6 } } }); // inline, without registering

Shader contract:
- GLSL ES 1.0 fragment shader. Start with "precision mediump float;". Write gl_FragColor.
- varying vec2 vUv: 0 to 1 across the photo's box, (0, 0) top left.
- uniform sampler2D uFrom, uTo: the photo leaving and arriving.
- uniform float uProgress: 0 to 1, already eased by the effect's easing.
- uniform vec2 uResolution: the box in device pixels.
- uniform vec2 uFromSize, uToSize: natural photo sizes in pixels.
- uniform float uTime: seconds since the lightbox opened.
- uniform float uDirection: +1 next, -1 previous.
- Your uniforms: number -> float, [a, b] -> vec2, [a, b, c] -> vec3, [a, b, c, d] -> vec4. Declare them with the same names.
- Predefined macros: coverUv(uv, texSize, resolution) cover-fits; mirrorUv(uv) mirrors into 0 to 1 (no edge smear).
- The lightbox clips to the rounded box and runs the open and close spring itself.
- Compile errors: onError({ reason: "shader", message }) and the lightbox uses the CSS renderer. Never a blank screen.
- Reduced motion replaces every effect with a fade.
- Effect object: { fragment, uniforms?, duration? (ms, default 480), easing? ("ease-out" default | "ease-in-out" | "linear" | (t) => number), css? ("fade" | "slide" | "zoom" | "none") }.
- Shaders run on the GPU with no network or DOM access. Only use shaders you trust; never compile user-supplied shader source.

--- 5.11 Videos mixed with photos ---

unfurl({
  photos: [
    { src: "/img/a.jpg", alt: "Terrace" },
    { type: "video", provider: "youtube", src: "https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ", poster: "/img/walk.jpg", title: "Pool walk" },
    { type: "video", provider: "vimeo", src: "https://vimeo.com/76979871", poster: "/img/v.jpg" },
    { type: "video", provider: "tiktok", src: "https://www.tiktok.com/@you/video/7212345678901234567", poster: "/img/tt.jpg" },
    { type: "video", provider: "instagram", src: "https://www.instagram.com/reel/C1a2B3c4D5e/", poster: "/img/ig.jpg" },
    { type: "video", provider: "mp4", src: "/media/tour.mp4", poster: "/img/tour.jpg" },
  ],
  origin: (n) => thumbs[n], // the poster springs from the grid
});
// Players load only on tap: youtube-nocookie, Vimeo dnt=1, official TikTok and Instagram embeds, <video> for mp4.
// They are removed (stopped) when moving on or closing. Changes to or from a video use a short crossfade.
// CSP: frame-src for the providers used, media-src for mp4 hosts. Bad sources fire onError reason "media".

--- 5.12 Extra top-bar buttons ---

unfurl({
  photos,
  topActions: [
    { label: "Remove this page", onClick: (api) => removePage(api.index) },
    { label: "Share", icon: "M4 12v7h16v-7M12 3v12M7 8l5-5 5 5", onClick: (api) => share(api.item) },
  ],
});
// Or mount anything: controls: (host, api) => { host.append(myButton); return () => cleanUp(); }

--- 5.13 React controls in the top bar ---

const lightbox = useUnfurl(photos, {
  renderControls: (api) => <button type="button" className="fk-unfurl-action" onClick={() => removePage(api.index)}>Remove this page</button>,
});
return <>{grid}{lightbox.portal}</>; // portal keeps your React context; needs react-dom

--- 5.15 A slider card that is also a link ---

procession(card, {
  photos: listing.photos.map((p) => ({ src: p.url, alt: "", placeholder: p.colour })),
  href: `/l/${listing.slug}`,  // Cmd/Ctrl/middle click open a new tab natively
  tabbable: false,              // the card's text link takes focus instead
  focusRing: "inset",           // the card clips overflow
  counter: true,
  zoom: true,                   // phone gallery: pinch and double tap
});

--- 5.16 Server rendering the slider (Next.js) ---

<Procession photos={photos} priority />  // the first photo is in the server HTML; no empty first paint

--- 5.17 Theming ---

:root { --fk-focus: #0b57d0; --fk-focus-dark: #ffd400; --fk-press-scale: .96; --fk-font: 500 14px/1.4 Inter, sans-serif; }

--- 5.14 Tidy up on destroy ---

const lb = unfurl({ photos, onCloseEnd: ({ reason }) => setOpen(false) }); // reason "close" or "destroy"
lb.destroy(); // e.g. on route change: still fires onCloseStart and onCloseEnd

====================================================================
6. RULES OF THUMB
====================================================================

- renderer "auto" is right for most sites. Use "css" when photos are on another origin without CORS headers, for the lightest path, or when WebGL is unwanted.
- Photos from a CDN with WebGL: the CDN must send Access-Control-Allow-Origin. Without it, frankaa falls back to CSS and fires onError with reason "cors".
- Always pass alt text. Captions are optional and shown under the photo.
- Pass origin so it springs from and back to the thumbnail; match radius to the thumbnail's border radius.
- When the lightbox is opened from a slider, keep the slider in step with onChange: (n) => slider.go(n, false).
- Give the slider's element a size (width from layout; height from aspect-ratio, default 4:3) so nothing shifts while photos load. Pass width and height on photos.
- Autoplay is off by default; leave it off unless asked.
- CSP: no eval, no innerHTML, styles through the CSSOM; img-src must allow the photos.
